coverage_note: Added 121 October 16 and 2 October 19 rendered SPY Magic alerts. Earlier captures retained. Yahoo Finance 1-minute close coverage October 16 09:14 through October 19 06:43 Pacific includes premarket and after-hours; earlier price history remains irregular saved observations. Close prices establish near → away → return sequences. Saved closes retire ITM crossings. Intraminute extremes are not used because the feed includes apparent outlier prints; brief crossings between closes may be missed. A crossing timestamp is the end of its observed minute, not an exact execution time. Missing bars and crossings outside retained coverage may be missed. Extended-hours underlying crosses do not imply options could be traded then. October 19 update adds observed SPY underlying quotes from the rendered Magic table, including 770.01 at 08:27:26 Pacific. This is the earliest crossing captured in this refresh, not a verified opening-bell or first-market crossing. Raw alert history and counts retain their prior capture coverage. October 20 refresh: 264 distinct rendered alerts across two pages, 06:33:43–10:56:21 Pacific. These underlying-price checks establish observed crossings only; October 19 afternoon and October 20 premarket are not newly covered by this capture. Existing extended-hours observations remain retained; missing checks are not evidence of no crossing.

latest_capture_summary.method: Distinct rendered rows across two pages, overlapping row deduplicated by complete rendered fields. Contract aggregates and underlying-price observations retained. Prior raw alert history preserved.
